propositions: Duplicate CAS push retry loops in workflows must be consolidated into a single Python core owner at src/rebar/_store/push.py
The strict push entrypoint must enforce a five-cycle retry budget, classify typed failures, and raise PushDeliveryError on exhaustion while preserving best-effort defaults for legacy callers
Workflow adapters must delegate push delivery exactly once through strict Python entrypoints rather than implementing their own fetch-merge-retry loops
The locked commit-and-push transaction must atomically stage, commit, and deliver with established bot identity and subject while handling dirty-tree and locally-ahead states
Existing Python library, CLI, MCP, and importer callers must retain best-effort semantics without modification while workflows explicitly opt into strict delivery
